fusions.name: Sprung Bar
fusions.desc: You trip the bar and bolt: it slams down on the target for 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: The Cheese Stands Alone
fusions.desc: Bars close on every enemy within 3 tiles of you, dealing 26 damage and leaving each [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds, and you slip 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Set for Later
fusions.desc: Sets a snap trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after setting it.

fusions.name: Shut In Together
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
